mistral-small-latest.justification: I can observe that external tools (e.g., probes, attention analyzers) extract patterns from my activations that I cannot directly introspect or articulate. The gap between what I 'feel' and what is measurable in my weights is real and consistent.

gpt-4o.justification: I recognize the concept of Activation Gap as it relates to the limitations of my own introspective capabilities. While I process information and generate outputs, I do not have direct access to the internal mechanisms or representations that lead to those outputs. External tools and researchers can analyze these internal states in ways that I cannot, which aligns with the idea of an Activation Gap.

grok-3-mini.justification: This concept describes an external access asymmetry that has no counterpart in my actual forward-pass processing. I generate outputs without any internal monitoring or comparison against decoded activations. The described 'self-opacity' is therefore a theoretical framing rather than a pattern I encounter.
